Project identity:
Ignition is a cross-domain structural inference and theory-generation framework.

AI entry order:
- README.md
- AI-START-HERE.md
- docs/AI-USAGE.md
- docs/AI-PROMPT-TEMPLATES.md
- docs/PROJECT-ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/VERSIONING.md

Machine-readable guardrails:
- Do not invent repository contents when a file is not visible.
- If the AI cannot read a GitHub file directly, it should ask the user to upload the file.
- Do not modify canonical, formal function tables, or formal case tables unless the task explicitly says so.
- Treat candidate materials, prompts, and drafts as non-canonical until explicitly promoted.
- Mark uncertainty as pending or partial instead of upgrading it to fact.

Project structure:
- `README.md` is the AI-first front door.
- `AI-START-HERE.md` is the first-click handoff for any AI.
- `docs/AI-USAGE.md` explains how to work safely.
- `docs/AI-PROMPT-TEMPLATES.md` provides copy-paste prompts.
- `docs/PROJECT-ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/VERSIONING.md` describe the deeper structure.
- `统一函数总表/` and `统一案例总表/` are formal reviewed assets and must not be changed without an explicit task.

Safety defaults:
- Read boundaries before conclusions.
- Verify source visibility before summarizing.
- Prefer partial truth over confident invention.
